text: When reviewing an alert on my credit report, I noticed that there was an attempted collection of a debt that does not belong to me. This collection company put on my report a series of addresses where I have never lived in order to collect a fraudulent debt. It is evident that they used my information to commit fraud. I have never requested these types of services and I have never resided at those addresses.
